subject: Emergency credit bridge request for Horizon Health pilot
messages:
From: Avery Brooks <avery@horizonhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>, Simon Lee <simon.lee@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: pilot blocked - need short bridge credit

Hi Jordan,

Quick note — our pilot environment hit a quota ceiling this morning and all integration tests stopped. The team is mid-eval and this is blocking our product demos with clinical partners next week.

Can Redwood temporarily restore ~75k tokens for the Horizon sandbox so we can finish the last two test scenarios? We can sign off on the pilot agreement and procurement is ready to expedite payment for next month, but we need a short bridge to keep momentum.

I'm attaching a usage snapshot and a proposed SOW (high level). Appreciate any fast help.

Best,
Avery Brooks
Sr. Product Manager, Horizon Health
(attachment: usage_report_Mar2027.csv, Horizon_SOW_v1.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Avery Brooks <avery@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: pilot blocked - need short bridge credit

Hi Avery — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. I'm sorry you're blocked. We can absolutely try to help while procurement finishes the SOW. 

Quick plan: I'll request an emergency 75k token bridge from our pilot credits pool. I need manager sign-off for exception authorization and a short confirmation from procurement that payment is in flight. Can you confirm procurement's ETA and whether the additional tokens will be used in one burst or over the next 7 days? That affects how we size the bridge.

I'll loop in billing/ops if we get a go.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: pilot-agreement-redline-20270404.docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: pilot blocked - need short bridge credit

Jordan — I can approve a one-time 75k token bridge from our sandbox reserve under the following conditions:

- Horizon confirms procurement will issue payment for the committed pilot by 2027-05-03.
- Horizon agrees to a temporary usage cap of 25k/day until the SOW is signed so we don't overshoot.
- We log the exception in the billing queue and create a follow-up to reconcile tokens or issue invoice credit as needed.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

On procurement ETA: if they can share a proof of payment initiation (PO or payment window) that's sufficient for our records.

From: Avery Brooks <avery@horizonhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>, Simon Lee <simon.lee@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: pilot blocked - need short bridge credit

Thanks Marissa/Jordan — Procurement confirms the PO is being submitted today and they expect payment processing within 7 business days. Simon attached the draft PO (see Drive link) and the team will honor the 25k/day cap.

We accept the conditions and will send a PO confirmation email once the finance team triggers the wire. Can you share any required billing reference so procurement can include it?

Appreciate the quick turn.

—Avery

(related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HorizonPilotDocs)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Avery Brooks <avery@horizonhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emergency credit bridge request for Horizon Health pilot

All — thanks for the quick coordination. Exception authorized: I approve a one-off 75,000 token bridge from the pilot reserve with a 25k/day soft cap enforced by ops. Conditions: procurement must share a PO reference or payment initiation email within 7 days and Horizon will acknowledge token reconciliation after the bridge (invoice or credit).

Dev — please apply the 75k tokens to the horizon-health-sandbox account now and enable the usage cap. Confirm when live.

Jordan — I'll note this as an "exception: emergency bridge" in the billing queue (RNW-5821) and will follow up if any further approvals are needed.

Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Sales & GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
